cost_ledger.progress: For simple and double fibers, source adjoint and unranking add only constant jet overhead plus B^(3/5) public root testing. The unresolved dominant object is now the scalar target norm/count circuit itself.

marker_adjoint_theorem.coupled_source: factoring the normalized homogeneous jet returns one complete ten-channel marker vector per coupled source
marker_adjoint_theorem.integer_count: the first nonzero jet order is exactly m
marker_adjoint_theorem.lowest_homogeneous_jet: if the target fiber is Z and m=|Z|, the first nonzero homogeneous term is product_(r notin Z) z_r times product_(s in Z)(t0+marker(s) dot t)
marker_adjoint_theorem.marker_deformation: replace each source factor z_s by z_s+t0+sum_(j=1)^10 marker_j(s)*t_j
marker_adjoint_theorem.multiset_inverse: Newton identities form the monic degree-five root polynomial; testing the public atom indices with multiplicity recovers the unordered source in O(|A|+|C|) field operations
marker_adjoint_theorem.reverse_mode_cost: Baur-Strassen gives constant-factor first derivatives of a scalar arithmetic circuit; a truncated order-m jet has overhead polynomial in binomial(10+m,m)
marker_adjoint_theorem.scope: Conditional on a compact scalar norm/count circuit that accepts the ten fixed marker deformations. The theorem does not construct that scalar circuit, prove an asymptotic fiber-multiplicity bound, or make explicit B^5 source products cheap.

next_action: Construct or refute the scalar target norm/count circuit now isolated by R105. It must consume compact D_A,D_C and T as one non-mergeable program, support the eleven unit/power-sum deformations, avoid B^(14/5) residuals, B^(11/5) translated coefficient reads, B^5 source factors, and oracle determinants, fit both caps, and prove a generic multiplicity/integer-lift gate before rank, factor logs, and identical descent.
novelty_scope: R105 is the first campaign receipt to make source recovery a lowest-homogeneous-jet adjoint of one target-injected whole-deck scalar norm, recover unordered 5A+5C sources from ten power sums, and replay double fibers without a source dictionary.
